## Decisions — immutable; never edit, only supersede

- [0002-drizzle-not-prisma.md](docs/decisions/0002-drizzle-not-prisma.md) · **L4**: pre-decided for the Cloudflare+Neon stack (production-port skill seed). Diverge by superseding with a new ADR and a §2 row — never by editing this one.
- [0003-react-router-8-framework-mode.md](docs/decisions/0003-react-router-8-framework-mode.md) · **L4**: pre-decided for the Cloudflare+Neon stack (production-port skill seed). Diverge by superseding with a new ADR and a §2 row — never by editing this one.

- [0005-time-is-an-argument-test-time-comes-from-data-fi.md](docs/decisions/0005-time-is-an-argument-test-time-comes-from-data-fi.md) · **L3**: pre-decided for the Cloudflare+Neon stack (production-port skill seed). Diverge by superseding with a new ADR and a §2 row — never by editing this one.
- [0006-tests-pin-confirmed-flows-four-levels-by-environ.md](docs/decisions/0006-tests-pin-confirmed-flows-four-levels-by-environ.md) · **L4**: pre-decided for the Cloudflare+Neon stack (production-port skill seed). Diverge by superseding with a new ADR and a §2 row — never by editing this one.
- [0007-one-reducer-effects-as-data-the-host-drains.md](docs/decisions/0007-one-reducer-effects-as-data-the-host-drains.md) · **L3**: pre-decided for the Cloudflare+Neon stack (production-port skill seed). Diverge by superseding with a new ADR and a §2 row — never by editing this one.
- [0008-errors-two-tier-rr8-boundaries-a-typed-taxonomy-.md](docs/decisions/0008-errors-two-tier-rr8-boundaries-a-typed-taxonomy-.md) · **L3**: pre-decided for the Cloudflare+Neon stack (production-port skill seed). Diverge by superseding with a new ADR and a §2 row — never by editing this one.
- [0009-logging-one-door-one-flat-json-object-platform-i.md](docs/decisions/0009-logging-one-door-one-flat-json-object-platform-i.md) · **L4**: pre-decided for the Cloudflare+Neon stack (production-port skill seed). Diverge by superseding with a new ADR and a §2 row — never by editing this one.
- [0010-schema-conventions.md](docs/decisions/0010-schema-conventions.md) · **L3**: pre-decided for the Cloudflare+Neon stack (production-port skill seed). Diverge by superseding with a new ADR and a §2 row — never by editing this one.
- [0011-ci-runs-the-cheap-half-honestly-deploys-are-scri.md](docs/decisions/0011-ci-runs-the-cheap-half-honestly-deploys-are-scri.md) · **L4**: pre-decided for the Cloudflare+Neon stack (production-port skill seed). Diverge by superseding with a new ADR and a §2 row — never by editing this one.
- [0012-seams-decided-in-advance.md](docs/decisions/0012-seams-decided-in-advance.md) · **L3**: which boundaries every app on this stack draws before writing features, which it deliberately does not, and how each is enforced. The governing principle and per-seam map live in the production-port skill's `references/architecture.md`.
- [0013-the-walking-skeleton.md](docs/decisions/0013-the-walking-skeleton.md) · **L3**: why this repo began as a copy of the spanning template, what the exemplar was, and the rule that governs additions to the pattern set.
- [0014-choosing-a-cloudflare-storage-primitive.md](docs/decisions/0014-choosing-a-cloudflare-storage-primitive.md) · **L3**: decides HOW to pick a store for a new kind of data. ADR-0001 decided the primary store (Neon Postgres via Hyperdrive) and stays the default; this one decides when something else earns a place beside it. It does not decide deferred execution (ADR-0015) or caching of whole HTTP responses at the edge, which is the one Cache API row below.
- [0015-choosing-how-deferred-work-runs.md](docs/decisions/0015-choosing-how-deferred-work-runs.md) · **L3**: decides what runs work that is not part of the response. Does not decide where that work stores state (ADR-0014) or how it is observed (ADR-0016).
- [0016-observability-depth-logs-traces-and-the-price-ch.md](docs/decisions/0016-observability-depth-logs-traces-and-the-price-ch.md) · **L3**: decides how much observability to buy and when to add the next layer. ADR-0009 decided the log SHAPE (one wide event, one flat JSON object) and still holds; this decides the layers around it. Superseded from ADR-0009: its "traces enabled while free" now has a date.
- [0017-cold-start-is-budgeted-bundle-and-startup-cpu.md](docs/decisions/0017-cold-start-is-budgeted-bundle-and-startup-cpu.md) · **L4**: decides how module-scope cost is kept honest. Does not decide request-time latency, which is placement (ADR-0019).
- [0018-generated-config-types-are-verified-not-trusted.md](docs/decisions/0018-generated-config-types-are-verified-not-trusted.md) · **L4**: decides how `worker-configuration.d.ts` stays true. Does not decide route types (`react-router typegen`, already covered by `npm run gate`).
- [0019-worker-placement-is-measured-not-assumed.md](docs/decisions/0019-worker-placement-is-measured-not-assumed.md) · **L4**: decides where the Worker executes relative to the database. Does not decide connection pooling (Hyperdrive, ADR-0001) or cold start (ADR-0017).
- [0020-release-mechanics-versions-preview-urls-rollback.md](docs/decisions/0020-release-mechanics-versions-preview-urls-rollback.md) · **L4**: decides what happens around `wrangler deploy`. ADR-0011 decided deploys are scripted and manual, not CI-triggered, and that still holds — everything here runs from the same machine, by hand.
- [0021-runtime-parity-in-tests.md](docs/decisions/0021-runtime-parity-in-tests.md) · **L4**: decides which runtime each test tier executes in. ADR-0006 decided the four tiers and what each navigates; that taxonomy is unchanged.
- [0022-choosing-a-model-access-path.md](docs/decisions/0022-choosing-a-model-access-path.md) · **L3**: decides how the app reaches a model. ADR-0012 decided the *seam* (`src/lib/ai/`, one door, provider DTOs stop there) and that is unchanged — everything here happens behind that door. Vector storage is ADR-0014.
- [0023-choosing-an-edge-request-primitive.md](docs/decisions/0023-choosing-an-edge-request-primitive.md) · **L3**: decides what runs at the request edge rather than in a loader. Does not decide authentication (ADR-0004) or where the Worker executes (ADR-0019).
- [README.md](docs/decisions/README.md): Decisions (ADRs)
